items.title: Fair Isaac (FICO) Stock Shrugs Off Q4 Results Despite Debt Questions
items.summary: Fair Isaac just delivered its Q4 2026 scorecard and the stock barely flinched. Shares closed up 0.9% at about US$707, a modest move for a credit analytics heavyweight that reported US$657.0m in quarterly revenue and non GAAP earnings per share of US$11.10. The mood in the tape points to calm. The financials tell a stronger story of rich margins and hefty free cash flow rubbing against investor nerves about valuation and debt.
